title: Event rotation-surface tilt shared adapter
hypothesis: Inside the strongest current event-bundle paper alpha, rotation_breakout_leadership event rows deserve a 3.0x paper-notional tilt and should be exposed by the shared default-off production adapter for forward replacement-value tracking.
single_causal_variable: rotation_breakout_leadership paper_notional_scalar in shared event_sleeve_bundle attribution

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260510-001: 3.0x rotation-surface paper tilt improved EV in all three canonical windows versus the current 2.0x non-generic state-surface event add-on.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260509-024: Avoided rejected broad benchmark gates on the event bundle.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260509-020: Avoided nearby PEAD price/volume threshold retuning.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260510-002: SEC/earnings filing shock remains data-blocked, so this run used a replayable event-state surface instead.

parameters.eligibility_rule: state score > 0 and state surface is not generic; rotation_breakout_leadership uses 3.0x paper scalar

expected_value_score_delta_reason: Paper event overlay EV delta versus the current event lead from exp-20260510-001; canonical core EV delta is 0 because the adapter remains default-off and does not alter orders.

gate4.basis: exp-20260510-001 improved event paper EV in all three canonical windows; this run reran the canonical core windows to verify no order-path drift.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM soft-ranking remains sample-limited; this alpha uses replayable PIT event-state fields.

decision_rationale: Accepted as a production-visible default-off paper adapter because the alpha evidence is positive across three windows and the implemented path cannot alter live/default orders.
risk_of_change: Forward paper attribution may over-concentrate a small rotation event subset; live promotion still needs closed forward replacement-value evidence.
next_action: Collect forward paper replacement-value outcomes under the exact shared rotation_tilt annotation before any trade-enabled adapter.
why_not_other_attractive_points: Skipped LLM ranking and SEC earnings filing-shock grading because current data coverage is insufficient; skipped PEAD retunes, broad event benchmark gates, event source pruning, and core A/B threshold work because recent mechanism logs rejected nearby variants.
